name: Gross-Flohmarkt Messplatz

rhythm.de: Mehrmals im Jahr auf dem Messplatz
rhythm.en: Several times a year on the Messplatz

facts: outdoor, on the Messplatz at Durlacher Allee
mostly second-hand; new goods only in limited numbers
the organiser asks visitors to come by tram
no parking for sellers on or around the Messplatz
sellers pay 10 € a metre for second-hand goods, 25 € for new goods
notes: The organiser publishes only this one Messplatz date (Sat 14.11.2026) — the earlier 2026 editions are past and nothing beyond is listed, so 'rhythm' is my summary, not a sentence from the site; the site states no frequency. Visitor entry fee is not stated anywhere on the organiser's site. Postal code 76137 is the organiser's own; the geocoder returns 76131 for the same square. E-mail from the Impressum; the events page also gives info-flohmarkt@gmx.com for bookings.

description.de: Mehrmals im Jahr auf dem Messplatz an der Durlacher Allee, 8 bis 15 Uhr. Überwiegend Gebrauchtes, Neuware nur in kleiner Zahl. Der Veranstalter bittet, mit der Tram zu kommen — rund um den Messplatz gibt es keine Parkplätze für Verkäufer.
description.en: Several times a year on the Messplatz at Durlacher Allee, 8 to 3. Mostly second-hand, with new goods in small numbers only. The organiser asks visitors to come by tram — there is no seller parking anywhere around the square.
